query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQD_IMAGES ( STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID, IMAGE_ID, TEST, WAFER_SEQ, IMAGE_TYPE, IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_FILENAME, IMAGE_SERVER ) VALUES ( :step_seq, :defect_id, (SELECT NVL(MAX(IMAGE_ID),-1) + 1 + :image_id FROM TQD_IMAGES WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND DEFECTID = :defect_id), :test, :wafer_seq :image_type, :image_path, :image_filename, :image_server )
SELECT DEFECTID,MAX(IMAGE_ID)+1 AS NEXT_IMAGE_ID FROM TQD_IMAGES WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq GROUP BY DEFECTID

-- Create Date : 2013-11-13 12:05:14 SELECT * FROM TQD_IMAGES WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq

-- Create Date : 2013-11-13 12:48:02 -- SELECT * FROM -- (SELECT * FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq) D, -- (SELECT * FROM TQD_IMAGES WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq) I -- WHERE D.STEP_SEQ = I.STEP_SEQ -- AND D.DEFECTID = I.DEFECTID
SELECT * FROM (SELECT DFT.*, INS.LOT_ID, INS.WAFER_ID, INS.PRODUCT FROM TQD_DEFECT DFT, TQD_INSP_INFO INS WHERE 1=1 AND DFT.STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND DFT.STEP_SEQ = INS.STEP_SEQ AND DFT.WAFER_SEQ = INS.WAFER_SEQ) D, (SELECT * FROM TQD_IMAGES WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq) I WHERE D.STEP_SEQ = I.STEP_SEQ AND D.DEFECTID = I.DEFECTID

INSERT INTO TQD_IMAGES ( STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID, IMAGE_ID, WAFER_SEQ, TEST, IMAGE_TYPE, IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_FILENAME, IMAGE_SERVER, THUMB_PATH, THUMB_FILENAME, UPLOAD ) VALUES ( :step_seq, :defect_id, (SELECT NVL(MAX(IMAGE_ID),-1) + 1 + :image_id FROM TQD_IMAGES WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND DEFECTID = :defect_id), :wafer_seq, :test, :image_type, :image_path, :image_filename, :image_server, :thumb_path, :thumb_filename, :upload )

SELECT A.*, B.IMAGE_ID, B.TEST, B.IMAGE_TYPE, B.IMAGE_PATH, B.IMAGE_FILENAME, B.IMAGE_SERVER, B.THUMB_PATH, B.THUMB_FILENAME FROM TQD_DEFECT A, TQD_IMAGES B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND A.DEFECTID IN (??) AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ AND A.DEFECTID = B.DEFECTID

-- Create Date : 2019-06-18 19:44:13 SELECT T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP, T1.WAFER_ID, T1.STEP_ID, T2.*, T3.IMAGE_ID, T3.TEST, T3.IMAGE_TYPE, T3.IMAGE_PATH, T3.IMAGE_FILENAME, T3.IMAGE_SERVER, T3.THUMB_PATH, T3.THUMB_FILENAME FROM TQD_INSP_INFO T1, TQD_DEFECT T2, TQD_IMAGES T3 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.STEP_SEQ = T2.STEP_SEQ AND T1.WAFER_SEQ = T2.WAFER_SEQ AND T2.STEP_SEQ = T3.STEP_SEQ AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = T3.WAFER_SEQ AND T2.DEFECTID = T3.DEFECTID AND T1.STEP_SEQ IN (??) ORDER BY T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP, T1.WAFER_ID, T1.STEP_ID,T2.DEFECTID, T3.IMAGE_ID
